summary: Li Auto Inc., via its Hong Kong-listed equity issuer, filed a Next Day Disclosure Return under HKEX Main Board Rule 13.25A on August 10, 2026, reporting a repurchase of 490,050 ordinary shares at USD 6.4721 per share on August 7, 2026. The repurchased shares were held as treasury shares, reducing issued shares (excluding treasury) from 1,732,081,403 to 1,731,591,353, a 0.0283% decrease. This is a routine share buyback disclosure, a capital return to shareholders. Watch for continued repurchase activity and potential impact on share price and treasury balance.
